The test image shows a single detached tomato leaf on a sandy surface with diffuse yellow-green patches - this is a hallmark presentation of **Leaf Mold**, where yellow spots appear on the upper leaf surface corresponding to fungal growth (Fulvia fulva) underneath. The CDDM_1006.jpg reference was nearly identical in presentation: same substrate, same leaf shape, same yellow patch pattern.
